summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all task requirements (three retention policies, dry-run mode, error handling, GitHub Actions integration). Unit tests (ArtifactCleanup.Tests.ps1) are well-structured with clear Describe blocks targeting each policy, edge cases (boundary dates, empty lists, unparseable input), and policy precedence. Integration tests (Workflow.Tests.ps1) verify workflow structure, actionlint compliance, and end-to-end execution via act with 3 fixture-driven test cases producing exact expected values. Strengths: excellent organization, good use of fixtures and helpers (New-TestArtifact), independent tests, deterministic testing with fixed 'now' time. Weaknesses: some edge cases missing (tie-breaking for artifacts with identical dates, invalid policy values like negative MaxAgeDays, zero-sized artifacts); workflow tests depend on external tools (git, act, powershell-yaml module) which could fail if not available; no tests for specific failure modes (fixture parsing errors, missing referenced files, job timeouts). The tests define a clear contract for the implementation module (expected function signatures, return types, property names) but assume it exists without verifying. Would catch most regressions in core functionality but some edge scenarios and integration failure modes lack explicit coverage.
